seo.title: Kavanagh & Sons | Electrician in Kilkenny
seo.description: Family electricians covering Kilkenny City, Thomastown, Callan and Castlecomer. Fuse boards, rewires, EV chargers and fault finding. Call Tom on 056 776 2143.

hero.headline: Kilkenny’s family electricians, one call away.
hero.subhead: Fuse boards upgraded, faults found, EV chargers fitted properly. Tom answers the phone himself.

items.title: Family-run
items.text: Tom and his two sons do the work themselves.

items.title: Straight answers
items.text: A time you can hold us to and a price before we start.

items.title: Left tidy
items.text: Dust sheets down, everything cleared away after.

services.heading: What we do
services.intro: Domestic electrical work for homes across the county, from a tripping switch to a full rewire.

items.title: Fuse board upgrades
items.text: Old boards replaced with modern RCBO boards, labelled and tested.

items.title: EV chargers
items.text: Home chargers fitted on the wall or driveway, with the grant paperwork handled.

items.title: Rewires
items.text: Full and partial rewires, planned around the house so you're not left in the dark.

items.title: Fault finding
items.text: Tripping switches, dead sockets and flickering lights traced and fixed.

items.title: Lighting
items.text: New lights, dimmers and outside lighting, inside and out.

items.title: Smoke & heat alarms
items.text: Mains-wired, interlinked alarms for every floor and the kitchen.

about.heading: Three of us, one van, and our name on every job.
body: Tom Kavanagh has been wiring houses around Kilkenny since he was an apprentice. These days his sons Conor and Mark work alongside him.
We keep the business small on purpose. The person who quotes the job is the person who turns up to do it, and if something isn't right afterwards, you ring the same number.

process.heading: How it works
process.intro: No call centre and no waiting in for a window that never comes.

steps.title: Ring or send a message
steps.text: Tell us what's wrong or what you're planning. Photos help.

steps.title: We call out and quote
steps.text: A fixed price before any work starts, and a date you can plan around.

steps.title: The job gets done
steps.text: Fitted properly, tested, and the place left as we found it.

items.author: Siobhán D.
items.text: Half the house went dead on a Sunday night. Tom was out first thing Monday, found the fault in the kitchen and had everything back on by lunchtime. Couldn't recommend them more.

items.author: Pádraig M.
items.text: They put in a new fuse board and an EV charger. Tidy, on time and the price didn't change once. Conor was great to deal with.

items.author: Helen R.
items.text: Found a fault two other lads couldn't. Honest and fair.

items.author: John K.
items.text: Good job on the rewire, would use again. Had to wait a week for a slot but it was worth it.

area.heading: Where we work
area.intro: Based in Kilkenny City and out every day across the county.
area.note: Just outside these? Ring and ask.

cta.heading: Lights tripping, a board to upgrade, or a charger to fit?
cta.text: Ring Tom directly. If he's on a job he'll call you back the same day.

contact.heading: Get a quote
contact.intro: Tell us a bit about the job and we'll come back to you, usually the same day.
contact.success: Thanks, that's with us. We'll be in touch today or first thing tomorrow.
